project.name: Greenfield Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 2 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Greenfield qualifies as a local detour through Abbey Farm Museum and Greenfield Valley Museum. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Greenfield: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Greenfield offers Abbey Farm Museum, Greenfield Valley Museum, Greenfield Valley Rail and Steam Museum within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Abbey Farm Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Abbey Farm Museum and Greenfield Valley Museum, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Greenfield Valley Rail and Steam Museum
